metas.name: ★ 2.2 · 2025 · Snow White
metas.description: A princess joins forces with seven dwarfs and a group of rebels to liberate her kingdom from her cruel stepmother the Evil Queen.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2023 · Wonka
metas.description: With dreams of opening a shop in a city renowned for its chocolate, a young and poor Willy Wonka discovers that the industry is run by a cartel of greedy chocolatiers.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · The Little Mermaid
metas.description: A young mermaid makes a deal with a sea witch to trade her beautiful voice for human legs so she can discover the world above water and impress a prince.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Flow
metas.description: Cat is a solitary animal, but as its home is devastated by a great flood, he finds refuge on a boat populated by various species, and will have to team up with them despite their differences.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.
